faqs.q: What is the InkyBay affiliate program?
faqs.a: A way to earn by recommending InkyBay, the product customizer for Shopify, to merchants who sell custom products.
Creators, educators, agencies, freelancers and print experts whose audience includes Shopify merchants or people starting a custom product business.

faqs.q: How do I earn a commission?
faqs.a: You earn when a merchant installs InkyBay through your referral link and starts a paid plan. The commission terms are shared when you are approved.

faqs.q: Does it cost anything to join?
faqs.a: No. Joining the affiliate program is free.

faqs.q: What is the difference from the partner program?
faqs.a: Affiliates earn by referring merchants. Partners are apps, agencies and theme developers listed in our partner directory.
